method: a transverse bright band in the lower image, tracked as it descends. Crossing is inferred from the band leaving the bottom of frame while the vehicle is moving. No map geometry is read
no_crossing_because: 1 sighting(s), fewer than the 3 required. A band seen once or twice is more likely glare than a marking
note: deliberately conservative: a band lost mid-frame yields no crossing. Missing a crossing costs recall; inventing one would corrupt every non-action built on top of it
